ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out start and end times follow what is agreed in advance; the venue may ask to change the times for its own reasons. Load-in through the front entrance is prohibited; follow the venue's instructions for the route. For load-in, load-out and construction work, the person in charge of the work, transport company, number of vehicles, set-up company, number of set-up staff and names of workers must be notified in advance on the venue's form. Two copies each of the venue floor plan and the electrical wiring drawing must be submitted by 10 days before the work date.
ops.catering: Decoration, flowers, audio, lighting, entertainment and commemorative gifts are arranged by the venue's designated companies; if you ask a company other than a designated one directly, you must notify the venue in advance and obtain its approval. For rental meeting rooms, tea and water (250 yen), self-service coffee (550 yen per person), and Western-style boxed lunches at 3,240 yen and Chinese-style boxed lunches at 2,160 yen (one-way containers) are available.
ops.parking: Partner parking lots are listed. For banquets and weddings, parking is free for 4 hours with spending of 3,000 yen or more per person; for the restaurant and Apple Eye, free for 2 hours with spending of 1,000 yen or more per bill (bring a usage certificate or parking ticket). Use for meetings, exhibitions, seminars and the like without food and drink is charged. For large buses and microbuses, consult the venue; paid parking lots are introduced.
ops.restaurants: The same building has the Italian restaurant Enchante on B1F, the lobby lounge Apple Eye on 1F, and the Japanese restaurant Fuyo and Chinese restaurant Ryuo on 5F.
